> Blog · Summit Az · 2026-09-17

# Summary
Draft for Kim titled "Tankless Water Heater Descaling: How Often in Arizona Hard Water". File status says draft, not published anywhere, but the page tracker shows `/blog/tankless-water-heater-descaling-arizona/` published 2026-09-16 with this keyphrase, so the live post and this file are the same topic (dates differ by a day; confirm which version is live).

# Key facts
- Focus keyphrase: tankless water heater descaling (5,400 US monthly searches, KD 21, Search Atlas). Old focus "how often to flush a tankless water heater" (40 / 29) retired.
- Secondary phrases with volume: tankless water heater maintenance (18,100 / 25), descale tankless water heater (5,400 / 19), flush service (880 / 10), how often to flush (390 / 24), hard water (260 / 27). Transactional and step-by-step terms deliberately left to service pages.
- Rank Math SEO title has no brand suffix (would exceed 60 chars). Slug `tankless-water-heater-descaling-arizona`.
- Internal links: 5 unique URLs confirmed live 2026-09-17. Brief slugs for the hard-water and tankless-vs-tank posts were wrong; live slugs used and only the tankless-vs-tank post linked.
- energy.gov pages returned 404 to the fetch tool, so no DOE link was cited.
- Pre-publish checklist: keyphrase placement pass, Arizona only, no Utah mention.

# Versions
- `.md` and `.html` in `blogs\drafts\`; banner `tankless-water-heater-descaling-arizona.jpg/.png` plus `_make_banner_tankless_descaling.py`.
